fields.name: Template
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330AE50 (esv::TimelineSystem, applies the end state of an actor; Toolkit ApplyActorEndState) creates the component on the actor (bg3.exe+0x3312E50), formats the Guid of the end state record as text, resolves it with ls::GlobalTemplateManager::GetTemplateRaw and stores the FixedString at +0x10 of the template (its id) through the optional-assign helper bg3.exe+0xAF2EF0 (which DecRefs the old value).

fields.name: TemplateType
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330AE50 passes 'template(+0x1C) >> 29' (the top 3 bits of the template handle = its type) as the second member; bg3.exe+0xAF2EF0 stores that byte at +4.

fields.name: HasTemplate
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0xAF2EF0 sets the byte at +8 to 1 on first assignment and tests it before releasing the old FixedString: the engaged flag of an optional<{FixedString, uint8}>. Created 0 (bg3.exe+0x3312E50).

open_questions: The first 12 bytes are one optional<{FixedString, uint8}> (engaged flag at +8), flattened here.
The creation helper writes 0, not the FixedString null value, into +0: the value is meaningful only when HasTemplate is set.
second_pass: Re-read the optional-assign helper bg3.exe+0xAF2EF0: FixedString at +0 (DecRef of the old one), byte at +4, engaged flag at +8 set on first assignment - all members settled on Windows; one live instance was all zero (not engaged).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
